notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Herd Baloth.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Beast token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
